messages.author: 21b977b571a0dbe8
messages.subject: AIL genetic map construction
parts: AIL can provide much higher mapping resolution. Is R/qtl2 capable of make genetic maps using the AIL population? Or can we treat the AIL as F2 and use qtl1 to make a map, then use it in qtl2?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: AIL genetic map construction
parts:
Genetic map estimation has not been implemented for AILs in R/qtl2.

I agree that you could treat it as an F2 and estimate the map, either in R/qtl1 or R/qtl2, but you'd need to rescale it, as the intervals would be expanded due to the multiple generations of recombination.

karl
